act_title: The Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992
title: Power to make regulations
text:
30. Power to make regulations.—(1) The Board may, by notification, make regulations

consistent with this Act and the rules made thereunder to carry out the purposes of this Act.

(2) In particular, and without prejudice to the generality of the foregoing power, such regulations may

provide for all or any of the following matters, namely:—
